name: Pelargonium roseum extract
description: Pelargonium roseum extract (CAS 90082-55-6 ), also marketed as Itır Çiçeği Yağı in Turkish-speaking markets, is derived from the rose-scented geranium plant. It delivers a characteristic floral-rosy fragrance profile valued across personal care and flavoring applications. It functions primarily as a natural fragrance ingredient and flavoring agent in finished consumer and industrial formulations. In personal care, it is incorporated into perfumes, skin creams, lotions, and soaps to impart a fresh, rose-like scent. This extract offers recognized consumer appeal across various cosmetic sectors. Food and beverage formulators use it as a natural flavoring in confectionery, baked goods, and botanical beverages where a delicate floral note is required. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers incorporate it into oral care products and herbal preparations. It serves as a flavoring component to improve palatability in these specialized health and wellness applications. Fragrance houses also source it as a blending ingredient in fine fragrance compositions targeting natural and botanical positioning. Pelargonium roseum extract is typically supplied as a liquid essential oil or concentrated extract. Both solvent-extracted and steam-distilled variants are available depending on specific application requirements. Standard supply grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications to meet the compliance needs of buyers. These grades ensure the material meets the necessary safety and quality benchmarks for global distribution.
